title: Bucs' Luke Goedeke on fight with Jets: I'm not gonna get punked and not do anything about it

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Bucs' Luke Goedeke on fight with Jets: I'm not gonna get punked and not do anything about it
sources.description: Buccaneers offensive tackle Luke Goedeke got into a practice-field skirmish in a joint practice with the Jets today, and afterward he said he'll never back down to anyone.
